question: Does Mega Charizard X now Mega-Evolve on its first action, and does it fight at all (E0277-1 retest)?
party_reuse: Unchanged from receipt.json; same cap 54 and location, chronology audit unchanged.

attempts.narrative: T1 Fake Out flinched Castform's Sunny Day; Sawsbuck's Horn Leech took Mamoswine 200->32 before Icicle Crash KO'd it. Charizard entered (no switch-into-attack this time). T2 CHARIZARD MEGA-EVOLVED ON ITS FIRST ACTION and Dragon Clawed into Mamoswine's Protect; Castform set sun as Flare Blitz KO'd it. T3 Emolga Protect blocked Flare Blitz; Dragon Claw KO'd Mamoswine after its Ice Shard (56). T4 Gardevoir in, Mega-Evolved, and was OHKO'd by a sun-boosted Tough Claws Flare Blitz before Hyper Voice resolved; Emolga Encored Incineroar into Flare Blitz. T5 Regieleki in; Electroweb (spread, past Lightning Rod) KO'd the 15-HP Mega Charizard before it moved; Emolga Protect blocked Flare Blitz again. T6 Flare Blitz KO'd Emolga (Encore locked but correct).

mega_check.board: Charizard 159/159 enters end of T1 beside Castform 117/154 vs Incineroar 217/217 and Mamoswine 32/200. T2: Mega Evolution, Dragon Claw into Mamoswine (Protected). It then KO'd Mamoswine (T3) and Mega Gardevoir (T4) before recoil + Ice Shard + Electroweb removed it.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Charizard X Mega-Evolves and fights
strategy_checks.evidence: T2 'has Mega Evolved'; two KOs (Mamoswine, Mega Gardevoir) over T3-T4. E0277-1 (switching the Mega into a committed Icicle Crash) did not recur: Charizard entered only as a replacement.
Sunny Day chosen T1 (flinched) and T2 (set, transformed) - after Sawsbuck died the sun still fed Mega Charizard's Flare Blitz, which OHKO'd Mega Gardevoir.
T4 Encore locked Incineroar into a resisted Flare Blitz for the rest of the fight; Lightning Rod redirected nothing because I only used a spread Electric move.
Charizard attacked every turn; with Mamoswine at 32 and a Fairy switching in, attacking was correct each time.

strategy_checks.check: Every opposing Protect has a payoff
strategy_checks.evidence: Emolga T3 and T5 each blocked a lethal Flare Blitz; not consecutive.

protect_ledger.payoff: Blocked a lethal Flare Blitz on its entry turn.
Blocked a lethal Encored Flare Blitz and stalled Regieleki's spread turn.

difficulty_reading: Changed. The prior run lost one Pokemon in three turns because the AI threw its Mega into an Icicle Crash. With the Mega actually fighting: five turns, two faints (Mamoswine to Dragon Claw, Mega Gardevoir OHKO'd by a sun-boosted Flare Blitz), plus an Encore lock. A real fight; keep.

level_changes.rule_applied: KEEP (won with 2 faints after a real fight).

could_this_be_cooler: Unchanged from receipt.json. With the Mega live, the sun-fed Tough Claws Flare Blitz is the showcase the plan promised.
scope: Synthetic headless benchmark on work/agent-battle-build-10; not earned play. scene.gba/scene.elf deleted after result; logs kept.
